newsitem.title: USA: U.S. Robotics launches Pilot for Mac users.
newsitem.headline: U.S. Robotics launches Pilot for Mac users.

text.p: U.S. Robotics on Tuesday launched its Pilot Macintosh desktop software and connectivity pack, enabling users of the organizer to connect with either Macintosh or Windows computers.

Pilot is a handheld computer designed to work as a companion to a desktop or laptop computer, to help users manage schedules and personal information when they do not have access to their principal computer.
Pilot includes personal information management software such as a date book, address book, to-do list, calculator, and note-taking applications and connectivity software.
The product is priced at $249. U.S. Robotics said Macintosh users had requested connection capabilities, previously available only for Windows users.
